description: Scroll with the mouse wheel (human-like), the page or a scrollable element (ref). Either by `amount` pixels in `direction`, or repeatedly for infinite feeds: until `untilCount` elements match `selector`, or until the end (`untilEnd`), capped by maxSteps. Returns what happened and the snapshot.

container.description: CSS selector of the scrollable element, when it has no ref (feeds, chat panes).

selector.description: CSS selector of the feed items to count (with untilCount).

snapshot.description: Return the snapshot (false: only the summary).

untilCount.description: Keep scrolling until at least this many elements match selector.

untilEnd.description: Keep scrolling until nothing more loads.

name: scroll
